title: Messerschmitt's 1952 interview with a French paper

tellings.quote: Messerschmitt in '52 gives this interview to this French paper and he says, "If you see UFOs in the sky, they're probably the ones that I designed and was built by, you know, the Habermohl project and, you know, Škoda Works under Hans Kammler.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1952 Willy Messerschmitt, the German aircraft designer, gave an interview to a French newspaper. According to Michels, Messerschmitt said that if people saw UFOs in the sky, they were probably craft he had designed, built through a design effort called the Habermohl project at the Škoda Works, a big industrial plant, under a German official named Hans Kammler. If true, it would mean some UFO sightings were secret human aircraft that came out of wartime Germany.
